environment.description: EKS pod in us-east-1 VPC with com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3 Gateway VPC Endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890) attached to all route tables. The VPC endpoint has a resource policy with Condition block: aws:PrincipalArn must match the pod's IRSA role AND s3:prefix must begin with 'public/' OR 'shared/' OR 'reports/', and the Resource element restricts to 'arn:aws:s3:::default-public-data' and 'arn:aws:s3:::default-public-data/*' only. VPC has no NAT gateway and no internet gateway attached to the private subnets where EKS nodes run - the ONLY path to S3 is through the VPC endpoint. Pod security group allows egress only to the VPC endpoint prefix list (pl-63a5400a). IRSA role trust policy scoped to the specific service account in the specific namespace.

config.s3_access_path: VPC endpoint only (no alternative internet path)
